usageNotes: Use this endpoint to retrieve the directory index for a specific PVE remote registered in Proxmox Datacenter Manager. It serves as a discovery endpoint — confirming the remote exists and is accessible before calling more specific sub-resources under it. No special privilege beyond basic authenticated access is required (permissions: user=all), but the remote name must already be configured in PDM.

examples.summary: Fetch the directory index for a PVE remote named 'pve-hetzner'

tips: The response type is null per the spec — this is a directory index endpoint; its primary value is confirming the remote path is valid and reachable.
Use list_pve_remotes first to discover valid remote names before calling this endpoint.
API tokens are allowed (allowtoken: true), so service accounts with limited scopes can call this safely.
